name: 84092 · Sandy, UT
findings: ZIP 84092 (Sandy) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84092 (Sandy) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84092 (Sandy) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

observations.text: 18 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
